findings.entity: olives poured into glass jar (green olives in pouring bowl vs dark olives landing in jar)
findings.description: The pouring bowl and falling stream contain only green olives (00:00.000-00:02.000), yet dark purple/black olives appear in the jar starting at 00:00.500 (one dark olive at the bottom before any green lands) and by 00:01.500-00:02.000 roughly half the jar's olives are dark. No dark olive is ever seen in the bowl or in flight during this pour, so green olives effectively become dark olives (or dark olives materialize) with no visible mechanism.
